messages.text:
BL-1048 — A parcel waiting at a role's door reads as NOT-STARTED: the board's stage scan sees only opened mail, so BL-1037 (at QA) and BL-1032 (at the cleaner) both render NS
What it solves: Reported by the operator from the Pipeline Board topic, 2026-08-22: "1037 is
not NotStarted? there is a little bug in this grid?" - correct, and it was
two rows wrong, not one.
Approval context: Firm: a delivered-but-unopened parcel must stop rendering NS. That is the reported defect and the spec below fixes it.
Needs your call: whether the grid should DISTINGUISH "delivered, not yet opened" from "opened and being worked" - a second cell glyph plus a legend line. This spec deliberately doe…
BL-1048 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1048" (or "reject BL-1048 <reason>") to act.
